purpose: The smallest tolerance at which the TRUE configuration still explains the real data is exactly max_r |d_estimated(r) - d_exact(r)| on the shared leaf set: the L-infinity residual.  It is reported with the median residual and both relative to the median observed distance, so it can be placed on the same axis as Theta_k.
caveats: krepp distances are real ANI estimates on the same tree with the same generating sources; the exact partner is the model-implied distance vector.

published_biotrees is not a clean graded noise ladder: source weights are unpublished and the bank assumes equal weights, so the noise0 residual already exceeds the sequence-noise increment (stage 291).
krepp observed leaf sets can be a strict subset of the exact ones; residuals use the shared leaves only and n_shared records the overlap.
